_about: The assessment report as the student reads it on the result page (GAD-T606); staff pages show it in English. 'Examiner' in a report is the person who graded (Korean 채점자), never the AI examiner.
report.mock: AI scores in this report come from the mock panel, not a genuine AI evaluation.
report.preliminary: Preliminary: this grade has not been approved and is not a final grade.
report.missingNoneMore: nothing. Every part of this objective was shown.
report.contradictions: Where two of your statements met
report.contradictionsIntro: At these moments the examiner set two things you said side by side and asked you about them. They are shown in your own words, with your answer. Nothing here is scored, and nothing here says which statement was right: two statements that pull apart can be settled either way, and deciding which one you hold is the point of the question.
